prompt_text: Who is the best digital marketing agency in San Francisco?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” digital marketing agency in San Francisco — the right choice depends on your goals, budget, industry and preferred working style. I can narrow it down faster if you tell me what you need (see questions below). Meanwhile, here’s a practical way to approach it and a few well-regarded SF agencies by specialty.

Quick questions to narrow it:
- What’s your primary goal? (brand/creative, SEO, paid acquisition/PPC, social, content, product UX, growth marketing)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- Are you a startup, SMB or enterprise?
- Do you want a boutique agency or a large/global firm?
- Timeline / key deliverables?

Well-regarded SF agencies (by specialty)
- AKQA — strong in digital product design and experience-led campaigns (good if you need UX/design + marketing).
- Goodby Silverstein & Partners — creative-led advertising and brand campaigns (best for big creative/brand work).
- Prophet — brand strategy and growth consulting (good for repositioning and long-term brand/growth roadmaps).
- Huge — digital transformation, UX and integrated digital marketing (good for product + marketing alignment).

How to pick the best fit
- Match specialty to your goal (don’t hire a creative brand shop if you need performance PPC).
- Review case studies and metrics (look for ROI/CPA, customer acquisition numbers).
- Ask for references from similar industry/scale clients.
- Check reporting cadence, KPIs, and tools (Google Ads, Analytics, attribution, CRM integration).
- Compare pricing structure (retainer vs project vs performance) and contract terms.
- Run a small test project first (1–3 months) before committing long-term.

Where to find and compare agencies
- Clutch.co and G2 for verified reviews
- Ad Age Agency Report and industry lists
- LinkedIn searches and referrals from peers in SF
- Local meetups and startup incubators for boutique firms

If you tell me your goals, budget and company type I’ll send a tailored shortlist of 4–6 agencies in San Francisco with why each would fit and suggested next questions to ask them. Which direction do you want to go?
